title: Indexes, Constraints & Migrations
objectives: Treat constraints as the last line of defense
Ship expand/contract migrations with zero downtime

examples.name: migrations.sql

exercise.prompt: Order zero-downtime migration steps: "add nullable column", "backfill in batches", "deploy code writing both", "enforce NOT NULL / drop old column".
hints: Schema widens first; enforcement happens after data and code agree.

questions.explanation: Indexes speed reads and slow writes; add them where queries need them.

options: change schema without downtime, in backward-compatible steps
questions.explanation: Two releases of compatible schema let old and new code run side by side.
